description: Use this tool to model a facility energy scenario. Returns PUE-adjusted facility power in kW, energy in kWh and illustrative electricity cost in USD.

hours.description: Duration of the scenario in hours.

pue.description: Assumed power usage effectiveness, expressed as total facility power divided by IT power.

usd_per_kwh.description: Assumed electricity price in USD per kilowatt-hour.
